description: Owner decision 2026-11-05 approved a standing rubric so envelope tuning no longer needs owner interrupts. Implement it: (1) pin every Docker image used by UAT to a digest (docker/**/docker-compose*.yml and any image referenced by tests/uat), with a check that rejects floating tags such as singlestoredb-dev:latest; (2) a cell failing only with an infrastructure signature (timeout at the cell limit, OOM or per-cell memory cap, download error, SingleStore error 1712) gets exactly one automatic retry inside the same shard, recorded in the evidence and the gate summary; the gate passes only if the retry passes; (3) a script that reads trunk UAT history (rv2r-02) and reports cells whose infrastructure-failure rate exceeds 20% over their last 10 runs, with a ready-to-apply envelope entry when another scale of the same platform x benchmark stays gated. Agents apply proposals with cited evidence and a filed tracker item. Product-signature failures (wrong results, validation failures, crashes) are never retried or pruned.
